messages.author: d2bffd1a5d780ca8
messages.subject: Another warning message
parts:
Hello guys,

I hope you're enjoying this holiday.

I have another warning message when trying to fit unidimensional and bifactor models. In this case, my dataset is pretty small (n = 200), so I believe this might be the source of the message. My data has no missing values, is non-normal and comes from a five-point Likert scale with 27 items. As far as I think, there are no issues with the identification of the models.

I would appreciate your valuable help. Thanks in advance.

Here is my code:

unid <- 'GF =~ x1+x2+x6+x7+x8+x14+x15+x16+x18+x19+x23+x25+x27+x28+x29+x30+x31+x35+x38+x24+x33+x36+x39+x22+x34+x37+x41'

bifa <- '
GF =~ x1+x2+x6+x7+x8+x14+x15+x16+x18+x19+x23+x25+x27+x28+x29+x30+x31+x35+x38+x24+x33+x36+x39+x22+x34+x37+x41
F1 =~ x1+x2+x6+x7+x8+x14+x15+x16+x18+x19+x23+x25+x27+x28+x29+x30+x31+x35+x38
F2 =~ x24+x33+x36+x39
F3 =~ x22+x34+x37+x41
F1 ~~ 0*F2
F1 ~~ 0*F3
F2 ~~ 0*F3
GF ~~ 0*F1
GF ~~ 0*F2
GF ~~ 0*F3'

unid.fit <- cfa(unid, data = mydata, ordered = paste0("x", 1:42))
bifa.fit <- cfa(bifa, data = mydata, ordered = paste0("x", 1:42))

The warning messages are:

1: In lav_model_estimate(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavpartable = lavpartable,  :
  lavaan WARNING: the optimizer warns that a solution has NOT been found!

2: In lav_model_estimate(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavpartable = lavpartable,  :
  lavaan WARNING: the optimizer warns that a solution has NOT been found!

3: In lav_model_vcov(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavsamplestats = lavsamplestats,  :
  lavaan WARNING: The variance-covariance matrix of the estimated parameters (vcov) does not appear to be positive definite! The smallest eigenvalue (= 1.504327e-17) is close to zero. This may be a symptom that the model is not identified.

messages.author: 0325c6a976085eab
messages.subject: Re: Another warning message

I would start by fitting a much simpler model, and then add one factor at a time.

J
